headline: EU–OECD AI Literacy Framework sets a common reference
digest: The European Commission and OECD published the AI Literacy (AILit) Framework for primary and secondary schools: four dimensions, 19 competences and classroom examples. It is a ready-made reference for Actua curriculum mapping. In Canada, commentary turned to universities: The Conversation argued students need AI 'fluency', not just literacy, and University Affairs noted the AI Chairs expansion toward 200 and new post-secondary training roles.
